On April 28, 2026, at 5 PM, the main topic of the conversation involves several individuals discussing various aspects of performing squat exercises. Specifically, the participants are addressing issues related to breathing during squats, focusing on maintaining balance, and improving overall form. 

The discussion includes insights on how to maintain proper breathing during squats, which is crucial for avoiding dizziness and enhancing stability. Additionally, the conversation touches upon the importance of engaging the core muscles and the role of visualization in improving form. It also mentions the necessity of practicing controlled breathing techniques and suggests incorporating a warm-up routine focusing on breathing and relaxation to enhance squatting experiences. 

This detailed exchange highlights the importance of correct technique and preparation when engaging in weightlifting activities.
